Cors.//: No origins allowed by default. Development supplies http://localhost:4200 in appsettings.Development.json; a deployed frontend's origin belongs here or in an environment-specific override, never wildcarded.

Jwt.//: SigningKey is deliberately absent (CLAUDE.md 4.4). Supply it via 'dotnet user-secrets set Jwt:SigningKey <32+ chars>' in development, or the Jwt__SigningKey environment variable elsewhere. Startup fails if it is missing or shorter than 32 characters.
